cfg.raw_spark: A tool for landlords because tenants do not just pay late, they pay in random partial chunks nobody can reconcile.
cfg.grapeRel: my uncle, owns four rental flats

answers.m2: Last month a tenant sent three separate partial payments across two weeks, and Bram spent Sunday night matching bank transfers to the lease spreadsheet by hand.
answers.m3: My neighbor Tom, who rents out a duplex, told me last month he started asking for one lump sum only after a similar reconciling headache.
answers.m4: Priya, who runs a small storage unit business, keeps a manual ledger for partial payments too. For her the pain is chasing the balance down, the reconciling part is fine.
answers.m5: Bram uses a shared spreadsheet to track rent, but it has no way to flag a partial payment against the wrong month, so mismatches pile up.
answers.m6: "I just want one number a month, not a puzzle," he said after the Sunday one.
answers.m7: Owen only rents to corporate tenants on annual leases paid in full upfront. Partial payments never happen to him because the whole year is billed at once.

cfg.note: Sanitizer mutation probe — proven-bug regression.
